subject: Proposal: Split-PO milestone billing + optional Net30→Net10 early-pay path
messages:
From: Elena Morris <elena@starlark.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 08 Jun 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot billing structure + early-pay options for initial engagement

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Starlark is excited to move forward for the integration pilot. Our procurement team asked whether Redwood can accept split POs tied to milestone invoices. The ask from our side is:

- PO 12345 split into two invoices (50% on kick-off, 50% on go-live)
- Standard Net30, but we have internal constraints and are evaluating whether we can opt into an accelerated remit (Net10) in exchange for a small fee or a 1.5% discount to us.

Can you confirm whether Redwood accepts split-PO billing and whether you offer an early-pay option (Net10 / Net15) or an early-pay discount structure? If so, what are the routing/PO header requirements so our AP team can map invoices back to the PO correctly?

I attached a sample invoice and our AP contact.

Thanks,
Elena Morris
Finance Lead, Starlark Solutions
accounts@starlark.com
Attachment: Starlark_Sample_Invoice.pdf

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: Elena Morris <elena@starlark.com>
Cc: david_kim@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 08 Jun 2026 10:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot billing structure + early-pay options for initial engagement

Elena — thanks for the clear summary and the sample invoice. Looping in David (procurement) and Marissa (finance ops) to confirm the mapping. A few quick answers and asks from Redwood:

- Split PO support: Yes, we can accept split POs tied to milestone invoices. We need the PO number on every invoice line and the invoice should include a "Milestone ID" (we typically accept: KICKOFF, MILESTONE_1, GO-LIVE) to populate our intake fields.

- Early-pay options: We offer an optional accelerated remit program. Standard offering for pilot accounts: Net30 by default. Optional Net10 with a 1% flat fee (or 0.75% discount applied to invoice if you prefer discount model). We can also support Net15 at 0.5% fee.

- Routing & headers: Required fields to ensure automated routing to AP: PO Number, Redwood Vendor ID (we will provide), Invoice Date, Due Date, and a single-line Item Description referencing the milestone. If you use split lines, include the total PO amount as a header and then the line-level milestone amounts.

Action items for Starlark: please complete our Vendor Onboarding Form and return a signed W-9. I attached the onboarding form and W-9 for convenience (see attachments). Also include the AP contact and preferred remit email.

David/marissa — can you confirm whether the accelerated remit fee gets routed through billing or requires a separate credit memo process? Also confirm the exact Vendor ID I should pass back to Starlark.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
Attachment: Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf, W9_Starlark_Solutions.pdf

Kimberly / David — thanks for the fast reply. A few clarifications from our AP team after reviewing your notes:

- Confirmed: we'll populate PO 12345 on each invoice line and include the Milestone ID.
- For the early-pay model, we'd prefer the discount approach if possible (0.75% discount for Net10). Does Redwood apply discounts on the invoice total or via a separate credit on next invoice?
- Our AP needs the Redwood Vendor ID and the preferred remit email for the accelerated payments (some vendors use a different remit address for early-pay).

Attached is the sample invoice we mentioned. Can you also send the PO mapping CSV / header expectations so our system can automatically populate fields when generating invoices?

Thanks — we'll fill the onboarding form and return it within 48 hours once we have the Vendor ID.

Thanks for looping me in, Kim. Quick confirmations / next steps from Procurement & Finance Ops: 

- Vendor ID: Starlark Solutions will be assigned Vendor ID RDW-8731. Kimberly, you can share that back to Elena.
- Discount application: We apply an invoice-level discount at settlement (we do not post separate credit memos for the initial pilot). For Net10 with a 0.75% discount we record the discount on the invoice and the AP system nets payment accordingly — invoiced amount will show Gross / Discount / Net Due.
- Remit routing: For accelerated remit we use a single remit email (earlypay@redwood-payments.com). Please have them confirm if they want ACH or virtual-card settlement. ACH is preferred for discounts; virtual card can be used but incurs processing overhead.
- PO mapping CSV: attaching a small header example (PO_12345_split_example.csv) and a short mapping doc. Required CSV headers: PONumber, MilestoneID, InvoiceNumber, LineAmount, InvoiceDate, DueDate, RemitEmail.

Marissa — once Elena returns the onboarding form and W9, please create the vendor record and set RDW-8731 in our vendor master. Also create a billing note to allow the discount to be captured at settlement.

Kimberly — please reply to Elena with Vendor ID RDW-8731 and the DocuSign link for the onboarding form. I've attached the PO mapping example and flagged the remit email.

Thanks,
David Kim
Senior Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference
Attachment: PO_12345_split_example.csv
